guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Keep human conversation delivery explicit: the repository may print a report but cannot attest that a person received it.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Contract boundary, ai_finish stdout label, and direct relay protocol retain this limitation.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Preserve fail-closed Outcome validation and archive integrity; do not weaken verification to make reporting convenient.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Outcome validator stays mandatory; archive collision and worktree-digest regressions remain enforced.

guidelinesCompliance.guideline: Use structured Summary evidence for human-readable Outcome content; do not add self-congratulatory or unproven claims.
guidelinesCompliance.evidence: Observed issues, residual risks, verification results, guidelines, and user corrections are projected only from Summary fields.

risk.detail: Medium: a repository process can render and print an Outcome but cannot prove delivery to a particular human conversation; the agent must relay it before archive.

observedIssues.description: RFE-100 used default ai-finish behavior that archived the Work Item before the required direct human Outcome report.
observedIssues.resolution: Default finish now preserves active artifacts, prints a delimited Outcome, and only ARCHIVE=true requests archive.

observedIssues.description: A late Outcome refresh changed the output after the final archive worktree-digest anchor and blocked valid explicit archive.
observedIssues.resolution: Outcome is generated before self-referential stabilization; final aiSummary anchors the resulting artifact. End-to-end archive and collision regressions prove the order.

observedIssues.description: The Makefile consumed the ambient LANGUAGE environment variable as a report-language request, so an English default report could be silently changed by the operating-system locale.
observedIssues.resolution: Only the dedicated REPORT_LANGUAGE Make variable now selects a localized finish report; without it, ai-finish uses its explicit English default. Nested verification removes the override and rejects GNU Make's dynamic command-variable expansion before invoking project commands, and end-to-end retry coverage proves neither ambient LANGUAGE nor an inherited REPORT_LANGUAGE can change the default.

observedIssues.description: The pre-archive Outcome projection ignored a resolved Summary issue state and its recorded resolution, producing a misleading unresolved finding for the human report.
observedIssues.resolution: Outcome projection now preserves the recorded issue state and emits a resolution event when Summary evidence records one; an integration regression asserts both facts.

observedIssues.description: Even after subprocess filtering, ai-finish itself retained top-level Make report-language metadata, which leaked into pytest fixture subprocesses through the process environment.
observedIssues.resolution: ai-finish now removes report-language and dynamic Make override metadata immediately after parsing the explicit report argument; a regression verifies the nested command environment is clean.

residualRisks.detail: The script can only render stdout and active files; it cannot independently attest that a human read the report. The operating agent must relay it directly before archive.

reviewReadiness.reason: All required verification passed; residual risk remains documented.

userCorrectionsCaptured.request: Outcome files are evidence, not the human report; summarize directly in the conversation while the Work Item is active and before archive.
userCorrectionsCaptured.action: Default ai-finish keeps active state and emits a delimited report; archive is explicit.

userCorrectionsCaptured.request: Planned Work Items are already authorized; do not stop for redundant confirmations.
userCorrectionsCaptured.action: This corrective proceeds under the recorded continuous authorization while preserving direct-report-before-archive.

userCorrectionsCaptured.request: Conversation in English, Chinese, or Japanese must receive the Outcome report in English, Chinese, or Japanese respectively.
userCorrectionsCaptured.action: The operating agent explicitly passes REPORT_LANGUAGE=en, REPORT_LANGUAGE=zh-CN, or REPORT_LANGUAGE=ja; ambient operating-system locale is ignored.

userCorrectionSolidification: Makefile and installed Makefile.ai require explicit ARCHIVE=true instead of default archive.
Focused end-to-end and integration regressions cover the active report, explicit archive, projection, collision paths, and explicit report-language selection.
